bio: Robin Keith Annesley Ficker (born April 5, 1943) is an American political activist, real estate broker, former attorney (disbarred), former state legislator, sports heckler, and perennial political candidate from Maryland.
offices: Member of the Maryland House of Delegates (1979–1983)

items.t: Sued the Montgomery County Board of Elections over a Maryland law limiting payment to petition circulators; a federal judge ruled it void in 1986.

items.t: Promoted a county ballot initiative requiring the Montgomery County Council to vote unanimously to raise property tax revenue above the local limit; it passed in 2008.

items.t: Led a 2016 ballot initiative for term limits on the Montgomery County Executive and County Council members; it passed with 69% of the vote.
